headline: Bundesbank President Nagel highlights inflation risks and monetary policy vigilance
summary: Bundesbank President Joachim Nagel emphasized that central banks must remain vigilant and ready to adjust interest rates to counter recurring inflation risks.
why: The Bundesbank exerts substantial influence over European Central Bank monetary policy; hawkish stances from its president shape eurozone rate expectations.

impacts.name: Eurozone policy rate
impacts.why: Nagel signaled readiness to keep using rate instruments if price pressures persist.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
